# Agent Note 模板

选择对应生命周期，复制代码块正文到 `docs/decisions/{lifecycle}/{class}/YYYY-MM-DD-topic.md`。分类、保留条件和替代关系见[决策规则](../decisions/README.md)，格式由 `pnpm verify:agent-notes` 校验。

## proposed

```markdown
# Agent Note: <提案名称>

Status: proposed

## Problem

## Proposal

## Alternatives considered

## Acceptance criteria

## Risks
```

## implemented

```markdown
# Agent Note: <决策名称>

Status: implemented

## Problem

## Decision

## Alternatives considered

## Consequences
```

## rejected

```markdown
# Agent Note: <提案名称>

Status: rejected — <拒绝原因>

## Problem

## Proposal

## Alternatives considered
```
